gaps.lead: The bad weather meant we couldn't leave the house.
People thought the species had died out completely.
gaps.explanation: 'People thought it had died out' becomes 'it was thought to have died out'.

gaps.lead: She hates it when people interrupt her.
'Did you send the invoice?' the manager asked her.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether she had sent.

gaps.lead: The plane takes one hour; the train takes two.
gaps.explanation: half the time = twice as fast as.

gaps.lead: This is the best coffee I've ever tasted.
gaps.explanation: 'The best I've ever tasted' → 'never tasted better'.
